# AccessNow BD

> AccessNow BD is a trusted Bangladeshi marketplace for verified premium digital subscriptions — streaming, AI tools, productivity, education and design software — with fast delivery and bKash / Nagad / card payments.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured digital services, bestsellers and category overview.
- [All Subscriptions](/products): Full catalog of premium digital subscriptions.
- [All Categories](/categories): Browse every product category.
- [Streaming Services](/streaming): Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Hoichoi, Chorki and more.
- [AI & Productivity Tools](/ai-tools): ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Gemini Advanced, Grammarly, Quillbot.
- [Education & Creative](/education): Coursera Plus, Canva Pro, CapCut Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, email and contact form. Office 11 AM – 11 PM.
- [FAQ](/faq): Delivery, payment, warranty and support questions.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap): Human-readable map of every public page.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How we handle customer data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Site terms and conditions.
- [Refund Policy](/refund-policy): 30-day warranty and refund rules.
- [Delivery Info](/delivery-info): How and when accounts are delivered.
- [Order Cancellation](/order-cancellation): Rules for cancelling an order.
- [Refund Request](/refund-request): Submit a refund request.
